parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The near-duplicate signal (Jaccard 0.78) almost certainly reflects two test methods that exercise closely related but semantically distinct scenarios — `defaultsToV1WhenNoOverrideOrFlag` (no override, no flag) versus `returnsV1WhenFeatureFlagIsV1` (flag explicitly set to V1). Collapsing these into a shared helper would obscure the intent of each test case and couple distinct precondition setups. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where all participating records are test fixtures warrants no-action.
